SELECT su.student_user_id AS studentUserId, su.name AS studentName, m.name AS majorName, c.name AS className, AS statusText, AS pendingApplicationText, COALESCE(co.company_name, sis.company_name) AS companyName, COALESCE(p.position_name, sis.position_name) AS positionName, su.phone AS phone, sis.update_time AS updatedTime FROM student_users su
LEFT JOIN major m ON su.major_id = m.id LEFT JOIN class c ON su.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN company_users co ON sis.company_id = co.id LEFT JOIN position p ON sis.position_id = p.id
AND su.status = 1

SELECT m.name AS majorName, COUNT(DISTINCT su.id) AS totalStudents, SUM(CASE WHEN su.id IS NOT NULL AND = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS confirmedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN su.id IS NOT NULL AND = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hasOfferCount, SUM(CASE WHEN su.id IS NOT NULL AND = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS notFoundCount, SUM(CASE WHEN su.id IS NOT NULL AND = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sis.status IN (2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT su.id), 0), 1), 0) AS progressRate FROM major m LEFT JOIN student_users su ON m.id = su.major_id AND su.status = 1
GROUP BY m.id, m.name ORDER BY progressRate DESC

SELECT c.name AS className, m.name AS majorName, COUNT(DISTINCT su.id) AS totalStudents, SUM(CASE WHEN su.id IS NOT NULL AND = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS confirmedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN su.id IS NOT NULL AND = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hasOfferCount, SUM(CASE WHEN su.id IS NOT NULL AND = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS notFoundCount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sis.status IN (2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT su.id), 0), 1), 0) AS progressRate FROM class c LEFT JOIN major m ON c.major_id = m.id LEFT JOIN student_users su ON c.id = su.class_id AND su.status = 1
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, m.name ORDER BY m.name, c.name
